verdict.rationale: Netlify documents an official CLI (netlify-cli) that deploys sites from the terminal with `netlify deploy`, including anonymous deploys straight from the working directory, so no web dashboard is needed. The probe confirms official CLI documentation exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of CLI-based deploys (community items discuss Git-driven auto-deploys, not the CLI).

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my project directly from the command line without using a web dashboard

citations.quote: Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
Deploy directly from your working directory. No login required to start.
